lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: What type of vehicle is required to display a reflective triangular Slow-Moving Vehicle (SMV) emblem in Texas?

options.text: All student driver training vehicles operating on multi-lane highways
Commercial garbage disposal trucks collecting municipal residential waste
Any vehicle or farm tractor designed to operate at speeds of 25 mph or less
Passenger hybrid electric vehicles driving in high-occupancy vehicle lanes
